name: wcag-enforcer
checks: Automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks on UI files: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (or vuejs-accessibility) for components, axe-core in jsdom for HTML, and its own text contrast check for CSS, style attributes and JSX style objects.
runs: After a Write, Edit or shell command changes a .tsx, .jsx, .html, .vue or .css file, and again when Claude tries to finish a turn with failures open.
failure: Each failure goes back to Claude with file, line and rule. With blockStopUntilFixed on, the turn is held at most twice in a row.
missingDependency: A check whose tool is missing (ESLint without an a11y plugin, no axe-core/jsdom) is skipped and the status line keeps saying so, so it never reads as a pass.
configure: /config options enabled, configFile, extensions, eslintCommand, blockStopUntilFixed; project file .claude/guardrail-mods/wcag-enforcer.json for the rest.
results: A note in the tool result Claude reads, a status line count (♿ 2 WCAG failures in 2 files), a toast when it stops holding the turn.
troubleshooting: If the status line says eslint not running, enable jsx-a11y in your ESLint config. If HTML is never checked, install axe-core and jsdom in the project. Static checks catch only part of WCAG; keyboard, focus and screen reader tests stay manual.

name: design-guardrail
checks: Hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl colors, px spacing and font values, React style numbers and Tailwind arbitrary values in UI files, against the project's own tokens file (JSON, CSS, SCSS or Less).
runs: Before a Write or Edit to a UI file; around shell commands (refuses direct shell writes to UI files, checks what other commands changed).
failure: The write is refused with the token to use for each value. If the guard itself errors, the edit goes ahead (fails open).
missingDependency: With no tokens file it stands aside and the status line says so.
configure: /config options enabled, configFile, tokensFile, extensions, ignore, allow; project file .claude/guardrail-mods/design-guardrail.json.
results: A refusal Claude reads, naming the token; a status line count.
troubleshooting: Keep a value on purpose with a guardrail-ignore comment, or add it to allow. Projects without a design system simply have no tokens file and are left alone.
cli: modspack check (design gate) and modspack hook for other tools

platforms.codex: Partial: PreToolUse hook via modspack hook codex
platforms.copilot: Partial: preToolUse hook via modspack hook copilot
platforms.gemini: Partial: BeforeTool hook via modspack hook gemini

name: qa-gate
checks: Runs the project's lint, type check, spell check and test scripts from package.json (whichever exist) with CI=true.
runs: When Claude tries to finish a turn after changing code by any tool, the shell included.
failure: Claude is kept working with the failing output, at most maxAttempts times in a row (3 by default). Scripts over timeoutSeconds are stopped and reported.
missingDependency: A check with no script is skipped and named in the status line. npm's placeholder test script is never run. In modspack check, a check listed under quality.required with no script is BLOCKED.
configure: /config options enabled, configFile, packageJson, packageManager, maxAttempts, scope, timeoutSeconds; project file .claude/guardrail-mods/qa-gate.json.
results: A hold message with each failing check's tail, a status line (✅ qa-gate: 3/3 passed · no spellcheck script).
troubleshooting: Long suites: raise timeoutSeconds or set scope to changed. Wrong package manager: set packageManager.

name: secret-scrubber
checks: API keys and tokens (GitHub, Google, AWS, Vercel, Todoist, Slack, Stripe, Anthropic, OpenAI), JWTs, bearer tokens, private key blocks, URL credentials, generic password/secret pairs and every value of a .env file.
runs: On every tool result before it is stored (main conversation and subagents) and on every attachment (@-mentioned files, changed-file notices).
failure: Fails closed: if scrubbing errors, Claude gets a placeholder instead of the output.
configure: /config options enabled, configFile, patternsFile, showToast; project file .claude/guardrail-mods/secret-scrubber.json (disabledRules, patterns).
results: [REDACTED:<rule>] in what Claude reads, a status line count, an optional toast. The original value is never logged.
troubleshooting: A false positive: disable that rule by name. A missed format: add a pattern. Your terminal still shows real output; only Claude's copy is scrubbed.
cli: modspack security (finds committed secrets; the same rules)

platforms.codex: Unsupported natively (no hook rewrites tool output); modspack security in CI finds committed secrets
platforms.copilot: Unsupported natively; modspack security in CI
platforms.gemini: Unsupported natively; modspack security in CI

name: privacy-guard
checks: Real-looking personal and health data in content Claude writes: SSNs, Luhn-valid payment cards, IBANs, labelled dates of birth and government ids, medical record numbers, health insurance ids, named people beside diagnoses. Published test values and example.com addresses pass.
runs: Before a Write or Edit; only the values the edit adds count.
failure: High-severity values are refused with masked evidence; medium ones come back as a note. Values in test paths step down one level for review.
configure: /config options enabled, configFile, mode, publicContacts, ignore; project file .claude/guardrail-mods/privacy-guard.json (blockAt, noteAt, allowDomains).
results: A refusal or note with kind, line, severity and length only; never the value.
troubleshooting: Public contact details: list them under publicContacts or mark the line privacy-ignore. Shell writes are not checked by the mod; modspack privacy covers them in CI.

platforms.codex: Partial: PreToolUse hook via modspack hook codex
platforms.copilot: Partial: preToolUse hook via modspack hook copilot
platforms.gemini: Partial: BeforeTool hook via modspack hook gemini

name: security-scan
checks: Committed secrets (working tree and git history), personal and health data, tracked .env files, risky GitHub Actions workflows, risky package install scripts, client-exposed secret environment variables, public source maps and debug files; optional dependency audit and gitleaks/osv-scanner when installed.
runs: modspack security, modspack release-check, and in CI.
failure: Exit 1 when a confirmed finding at or above security.failOn (high by default) is open; exit 3 when a required scan could not run.
missingDependency: Optional scanners that are not installed are SKIPPED and listed; nothing is downloaded.
configure: modspack.config.json: security.failOn, security.history, security.dependencyAudit, security.externalScanners, security.accepted, exclude.
results: Markdown or JSON report with finding id, category, severity, confidence, path, line, masked evidence, remediation, release impact.
troubleshooting: Dismiss a false positive by adding its fingerprint to security.accepted with a reason; an accepted risk also needs approvedBy.

name: release-gate
checks: Runs every required gate (quality, security, privacy, accessibility, package by default) and returns READY only when each one PASSES.
runs: modspack release-check, locally or in CI.
failure: NOT READY with the failed, blocked or unverified gates listed, exit 1 (or 3 when a gate could not run).
missingDependency: A gate that cannot run is BLOCKED, which is never READY.
results: A release readiness report with each gate's evidence and the minimum steps to READY.
troubleshooting: Read the BLOCKED lines first: they name the missing script or tool.
